name: Daily login reward
description: Gives Episode 3 players Meseta once a day when they log in, with an optional bonus for logging in on several days in a row.

streak_bonus.label: Extra Meseta per day in a row
streak_bonus.description: Added for each day of an unbroken streak. 0: no streak bonus.

streak_max_days.label: Longest counted streak (days)
streak_max_days.description: The bonus stops growing after this many days in a row.

message.label: Message
message.description: Shown to the player before the amount.
